Game Overview

At its heart, Monkey Go is a animal game about dodge planes, munch on bananas, and explore vibrant levels in Monkey Go, an exhilarating arcade adventure. Simple controls promise fun for all ages, while collecting coins unlocks quirky hats for your monkey. Hone your evasion skills and stay patient to conquer each unique challenge on this playful escapade.
